children: BlackRock has adjusted positions in its roughly $300 billion model portfolios, increasing equity exposure while remaining constructive on artificial intelligence. According to ChainCatcher, the firm is directing more capital toward large-cap U.S. stocks and shifting some AI exposure away from industry pioneers toward companies it believes will benefit from or adopt the technology.
In its international allocation, BlackRock has reduced the size of its regional tilts toward the U.S., developed markets, and emerging markets, according to a Bloomberg-reviewed investment outlook.

title: BlackRock Expands Equity Exposure in $300 Billion Model Portfolios
